clue.text: Appears as very Italian when holding silver spear

indicators.note: the Italian word clasps the metal in its middle, as a hand holds something

parts.note: assai is the Italian musical direction for 'very'
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Someone describes how an Italian looks when gripping a silver spear.
explanation.walkthrough: ASSAI, a tempo marking in music (allegro assai), is 'very' in Italian; 'Appears as' and 'when' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: An assagai is a slender throwing weapon with an iron tip used in southern Africa.

clue.text: Depicter of various traits?

indicators.note: various suggests a different arrangement, so the word traits is reshuffled

explanation.surface: A portrait painter is someone who captures assorted personal qualities.
explanation.definitionFit: A painter or illustrator depicts scenes and people.

clue.text: Plague second company with drive

parts.note: Co is the business abbreviation for company
a drive or impulse is an urge

explanation.surface: A firm's backup unit with plenty of energy is a nuisance.
explanation.definitionFit: A scourge is an affliction or torment, as a plague is a widespread trouble.

clue.text: Fruit's stolen — it comes out of barrel very quickly

definitions.text: it comes out of barrel very quickly

parts.note: grapes are fruit; the 's turns into a plural here
hot is slang for stolen goods

explanation.surface: Some fruit has been pinched and is then shot out of a barrel at speed.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'barrel' sounds like a wine cask beside the fruit, but it is a cannon's barrel.
explanation.definitionFit: Small iron balls packed in a bag were fired from cannon as an anti-personnel charge.

clue.text: Did feminine parts in play, given proper compensation

indicators.note: the letters take new parts as actors would in a play, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: An actor played women's roles in a production and was duly paid for it.
explanation.definitionFit: To be indemnified is to be reimbursed or secured against a loss.

clue.text: Claimed changes to have point?

indicators.note: changes says the word claimed is altered into a new order of its letters

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether an altered assertion now makes sense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Point' is not the sense of an argument but the dot in a number like 3.5.
explanation.definitionFit: A fraction in base ten is written with a dot separating whole and fractional parts.

clue.text: One taken in by theologian, swindled

indicators.note: the numeral is enclosed by the two letters, as a guest is taken in

parts.note: DD, Doctor of Divinity, is a theology degree
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone was conned by a religious scholar.
explanation.definitionFit: To do someone is slang for cheating them.

clue.text: One who's concerned about being in vehicle?

indicators.note: the short word for about sits inside the vehicle word

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A worried passenger frets while riding in a car.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who looks after another person cares about them.

clue.text: Object to group's way of thinking

parts.note: to mind something is to object to it
a set is a group

explanation.surface: Someone resists a team's prevailing attitude.
explanation.definitionFit: A mindset is a fixed attitude or outlook.

clue.text: Dull event producing little illumination

definitions.meaning: the worst or least interesting moment of something

explanation.definitionFit: The worst moment is the opposite of a highlight; a dim lamp casts weak light.

clue.text: Ambidextrous — wanted hod adapted

indicators.note: adapted means the letters of wanted hod are reworked into a new form

explanation.surface: A builder who can use either hand asked for a modified hod.
explanation.walkthrough: A hod is a bricklayer's carrying trough, which suits the building-site picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Able to use either hand equally well is to be able to use both hands.

clue.text: We're upset about number to mend

indicators.note: about means the reshuffled letters go around the abbreviation
upset means the letters of we're are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: People are distressed about a figure they need to fix.
explanation.definitionFit: To renew something is to restore or repair it to good condition.

clue.text: Be in army reserves section?

indicators.note: a section is part of a word, so the answer lies inside reserves

explanation.surface: A soldier is posted to a part of the reserve forces.
explanation.definitionFit: To serve is to do duty in the armed forces.

clue.text: Sage one put in cooked Irish ham

indicators.note: put in means the single letter is placed inside the rearranged letters
cooked means the letters of irish ham are doctored into a new order

parts.note: a is the indefinite article, meaning one

explanation.surface: A wise man adds something to a dish of Irish ham.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sage' looks like the herb in a cooking clue, but it is a wise man.
explanation.definitionFit: A maharishi is a Hindu holy man and spiritual teacher.

clue.text: Recruiting, though not necessarily for school?

definitions.text: Recruiting, though not necessarily for school?

parts.words: Recruiting, though not necessarily for school?
parts.note: firms that poach executives look for top people; the question mark adds a school seeking a new principal teacher

explanation.definitionFit: Executive search firms approach senior staff to fill posts, just as a school must find a new principal.

clue.text: Problem with specialist knot

parts.note: technical means specialised or expert
a hitch is a kind of knot

explanation.surface: Trouble with an expert's knot.
explanation.definitionFit: A mechanical or equipment failure that holds things up.

clue.text: Worker given short holiday, reportedly — this could slow things down

parts.note: a hand is a manual worker

indicators.note: reportedly signals that the word for a short holiday is said, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: a break is a short holiday

explanation.surface: An employee gets a quick getaway, so they say, which might reduce output.
explanation.definitionFit: A lever-operated brake in a car keeps it stationary or reduces its speed.

clue.text: They don't use any sense normally

definitions.text: They don't use any sense normally

parts.words: They don't use any sense normally
parts.note: people said to rely on a sixth sense rather than the usual five

explanation.definitionFit: Clairvoyants claim knowledge beyond the ordinary five senses.

clue.text: These changes to illumination to include new atmospheric phenomenon

indicators.note: changes means the letters of these are put into a new order
to include means the abbreviation goes inside the word for illumination

parts.note: lighting is illumination

explanation.surface: Alterations to the lighting bring in a new weather effect.
explanation.definitionFit: A diffuse flash lighting up clouds, with no visible bolt.

clue.text: European went in drunk to embrace

indicators.note: drunk means the letters of went in stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: A continental visitor went into a bar drunk and gave someone a hug.
explanation.definitionFit: To entwine is to twist around, as arms wrap round in a hug.

clue.text: Indigenous people in sections of church, holding it back

indicators.note: holding means the church sections enclose the reversed word

parts.note: naves are the main central sections of churches

indicators.note: back means the word it is read in the opposite direction

explanation.surface: Locals in church sections are holding something back.
explanation.definitionFit: Natives are those born in a place, its original inhabitants.

clue.text: Shetland island editor showed sign of annoyance

parts.note: Yell is one of the Shetland Islands, north of mainland Scotland

explanation.surface: A newspaper editor on a Scottish island lost their temper.
explanation.definitionFit: To shout loudly in anger is a sign of annoyance.

clue.text: Part of plant colony Ted nurtured

indicators.note: nurtured suggests the letters of colony ted are brought up in a new shape

explanation.surface: A gardener named Ted raised a cluster of seedlings.
explanation.definitionFit: A seed leaf, the first leaf or leaves to appear from a germinating seed.

clue.text: Box outside duke's gatehouse

indicators.note: outside means the theatre box goes around the abbreviation

parts.note: a loge is a box in a theatre
D is the abbreviation for duke

explanation.surface: A box sits outside the aristocrat's entrance building.
explanation.definitionFit: A small house at an estate's gates where a gatekeeper lives.

clue.text: Graduate with article to cleanse?

parts.note: BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: A new graduate writes a piece on washing.
explanation.definitionFit: To bathe is to wash in water.

clue.text: I contended as a climber

parts.note: to vie is to contend or compete

explanation.surface: A mountaineer competes as a climber.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'climber' is not a mountaineer but the plant ivy.
explanation.definitionFit: Covered with ivy, the evergreen plant that grows up walls.

clue.text: Rather proper woman wearing a bit of lawn (ancient)

parts.note: prim means stiffly proper

indicators.note: wearing means the woman's name is clothed in the other two letters
bit of means just the first letter of lawn

parts.note: Eva is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A rather prudish woman wears a garment of fine linen called lawn, which is old.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lawn' sounds like grass but here it is just the source of an L.
explanation.definitionFit: Primaeval means belonging to the earliest age of the world.

clue.text: New success over word play

indicators.note: in a down clue over signals reading the letters upwards

parts.note: up means winning or ahead

explanation.surface: A fresh triumph is achieved in a word game.
explanation.definitionFit: A joke exploiting a word's double meaning.

clue.text: Woman visited drinking establishment

parts.note: she refers to a woman
been, as in 'have been to', means visited

explanation.surface: A woman went to an illegal bar.
explanation.definitionFit: An unlicensed bar, especially in Ireland or South Africa.

clue.text: Five hundred going to film, well oiled

indicators.note: going to means the number joins the end of the film title

parts.note: Grease is a 1978 musical film
D is the Roman numeral for five hundred

explanation.surface: Five hundred go to see a film and end up drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Well oiled' looks like slang for drunk, but here means literally lubricated.
explanation.definitionFit: Lubricated thoroughly, coated with grease.
